description.value: Fresh Slice Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain franchise offering by-the-slice and whole-pizza options with any toppings, available for in-store pickup, delivery, and online ordering. The Chilliwack location sits in a strip-mall unit on King Road, a busy commercial arterial. It is a straightforward quick-service stop for a touring cyclist needing a hot, filling meal.
